svg.text: GHOSTED: Auntie Dot model sheet v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Upright, neutral, symmetric turnaround. Body map v1 landmarks. Direction A (cottage loaf). Hand-drawn Bezier half outlines lifted to round bodies; palette rows only.
top of bun
hairline (centre)
eye line = ear points
neck line = headset band
shoulder joint
belly
hem
sole
FRONT
3/4 (front turned to viewer-left)
SIDE (facing viewer-left)
BACK
PALETTE (existing rows only, seats/lena-park.md)
11 #7A5596 cardigan dress, sleeves
15 #F2C79E skin: head, hands, legs
23 #FFF8EE hair + bun, buttons, eye glint
27 #C8C0D8 the OLD HEADSET round the neck (faded)
5 #7A4A2E shoes
22 #2B1E16 ink: outline, eyes, brows, mouth
13 #F0B43C props: Copium mark on the Skill card
24 #E9D3B4 props: Skill card edge (3D only)
Shade: base x 0.85 (neutral grey multiplier).
SHAPE RULES
- Toy pawn, cottage loaf: big round head on a
pear; 2.27 heads with the bun. 0.9 x Kit on screen.
- Hair: a soft wavy hairline, strands swept up
into a top-back bun. Nothing crosses the eyes.
- The OLD headset hangs round her NECK: band
behind the neck on the shoulders, a cup on
each collarbone. Never on the ears. No mic.
- Cardigan dress: placket, 2 buttons, 2 pockets.
- Rest pose: hands folded on the belly.
- Joins: continuous sleeve out of the body,
then the hand ball (3-mesh build, notes).
IDLE SWAY (front): rock on the feet, +-4 deg; the head lags 2 deg
slow, about 2.5 s a cycle; the feet stay planted
TALK BEAT: head tilts 8 deg, her right hand comes up, mouth opens
(red: shoulder, elbow, wrist; the other hand stays on the belly)
HAND OVER A SKILL CARD: her right arm reaches forward
card in the hand, face to the player; small lean (2 deg)
EXPRESSIONS (front)
rest: warm smile
talk
happy (the card)
64 px SILHOUETTE (front, 3/4; 1x and x4)
LINEUP AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): Dot estimate on the real ATS v1 grass
with Kit, Ricky, 3 Ghosties and the ATS. Colour, then grey (Lena's formula).
GAME CAMERA NEXT TO KIT (x3): rest, talk, Kit
grey below; 1x at the bottom
cardigan 11 vs grass 1: 3.61:1
cardigan 11 vs Ricky suit 17: 2.31:1; vs Kit shirt 14: 1.24:1
headset 27 vs cardigan 11: 3.36:1 (the lilac ring reads)
hair 23 vs skin 15: 1.48:1 (low: the hairline carries an ink line)
hair 23 vs Ghostie body 16: 1.04:1 (same white family: see notes)
skin 15 vs cardigan 11: 3.77:1
In grey: a light dome with a light bun on a dark pear; the face is the mid tone between. Kit is mid-grey, Ricky near-black, the ATS mid, the Ghosties white.
SIZE (estimate; Viet's blockout sets it):
Target 0.9 x Kit 75 px = 67.5 px tall.
This tile: 68 x 50 px facing the camera.
Calibrated: 1 u = 3.34 mm, so about 1.00 m
top of bun to sole (Kit is 0.977 m).
